say:1:1730510501:1.text: Aren't you curious? Everyone in Savannah is talking about it.
say:1:1730510501:1.source_cn: 当然是因为好奇啊！现在王都的人都在讨论这件事。
say:1:1730510501:1.male: Aren't you curious? Everyone in Savannah is talking about it.
say:1:1730510501:1.female: Aren't you curious? Everyone in Savannah is talking about it.

say:2:1730510502:1.text: His Majesty was so gravely ill that all those famous physicians couldn't do a thing about it.
say:2:1730510502:1.source_cn: 之前国王病重，请了多少名医都没用。
say:2:1730510502:1.male: His Majesty was so gravely ill that all those famous physicians couldn't do a thing about it.
say:2:1730510502:1.female: His Majesty was so gravely ill that all those famous physicians couldn't do a thing about it.

say:3:1730510503:1.text: So much has been going on lately, and His Majesty was nearly assassinated...
say:3:1730510503:1.source_cn: 最近出了这么多事，听说国王还差点遇刺……
say:3:1730510503:1.male: So much has been going on lately, and His Majesty was nearly assassinated...
say:3:1730510503:1.female: So much has been going on lately, and His Majesty was nearly assassinated...

say:4:1730510504:1.text: Who would've thought the King would suddenly recover?
say:4:1730510504:1.source_cn: 在这个节骨眼，他竟然不声不响恢复了健康！谁能不好奇？
say:4:1730510504:1.male: Who would've thought the King would suddenly recover?
say:4:1730510504:1.female: Who would've thought the King would suddenly recover?

say:5:1730510505:1.text: You should be practicing your card skills instead of dwelling on stuff like that.
say:5:1730510505:1.source_cn: 你要是真好奇，就练练牌技，多拿点青符。
say:5:1730510505:1.male: You should be practicing your card skills instead of dwelling on stuff like that.
say:5:1730510505:1.female: You should be practicing your card skills instead of dwelling on stuff like that.

say:6:1730510506:1.text: This place doubles as an information hub, you know? If you're that curious, why don't you spend your Azure Tokens and find out for yourself?
say:6:1730510506:1.source_cn: 听说会馆还能换消息，你拿青符去换情报不就得了？
say:6:1730510506:1.male: This place doubles as an information hub, you know? If you're that curious, why don't you spend your Azure Tokens and find out for yourself?
say:6:1730510506:1.female: This place doubles as an information hub, you know? If you're that curious, why don't you spend your Azure Tokens and find out for yourself?

say:8:1730510508:1.text: Knowing this place, getting that kind of info would probably cost me an arm and a leg...
say:8:1730510508:1.source_cn: 以我对会馆的了解，要打听这消息，要付出的代价一定大到吓人……
say:8:1730510508:1.male: Knowing this place, getting that kind of info would probably cost me an arm and a leg...
say:8:1730510508:1.female: Knowing this place, getting that kind of info would probably cost me an arm and a leg...
